"""Camera-guided controller for the single live RoboCasa episode.
Commands and resulting observations are retained under /app/output and /app/runs.
Only RGB, depth, camera calibration, and robot proprioception are used.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np, json, pathlib, time, traceback
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
r=Robot(); out=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); n=0
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')

def state():
 return dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'],obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
def base_yaw():
 c=obs.meta['cameras'];l=np.array(c['robot0_agentview_left']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,3];rr=np.array(c['robot0_agentview_right']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,3]
 d=l-rr;return np.arctan2(-d[0],d[1])
def record(o,tag):
 global obs,n
 obs=o;n+=1;p=f'/app/runs/{n:03d}_{tag}';o.save(p)
 ims=Image.new('RGB',(640,520))
 for i,(c,im) in enumerate(o.last.items()):
  ims.paste(Image.fromarray(im),((i%2)*320,(i//2)*260));ImageDraw.Draw(ims).text(((i%2)*320,(i//2)*260+240),c,fill='white')
 ims.save(str(out/'latest.jpg'))
 (out/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'path':p,'meta':o.meta},indent=2))
 print(p, 'eef',[state()[k] for k in ['eef_right_x','eef_right_y','eef_right_z']], 'fingers',[state()[k] for k in ['gripper0_right_finger_joint1_pos','gripper0_right_finger_joint2_pos']],flush=True)
record(obs,'start')
while True:
 f=out/'command.json'
 if not f.exists():time.sleep(.1);continue
 try:
  cmd=json.loads(f.read_text());f.unlink();typ=cmd['type'];tag=cmd.get('tag',typ)
  if typ=='observe':o=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none',seconds=cmd.get('seconds',0))
  elif typ=='act':
   a=np.zeros((cmd.get('steps',1),12));a[:,6]=cmd.get('grip',-1);a[:,11]=cmd.get('mode',-1)
   for k,v in cmd.get('values',{}).items():a[:,int(k)]=v
   o=r.submit('ee_delta',a,cameras=list(r.spec()['cameras']),include_depth=True,video='none',note=tag)
  elif typ=='goto':
   pos=np.array([state()[k] for k in ['eef_right_x','eef_right_y','eef_right_z']]);delta=np.array(cmd['target'])-pos
   yaw=base_yaw();R=np.array([[np.cos(yaw),-np.sin(yaw),0],[np.sin(yaw),np.cos(yaw),0],[0,0,1]])
   delta=R.T@delta;steps=cmd.get('steps',max(10,int(np.linalg.norm(delta)/.008)))
   a=np.zeros((steps+cmd.get('settle',10),12));a[:,6]=cmd.get('grip',-1);a[:,11]=-1;a[:steps,:3]=delta/(.05*steps)
   o=r.submit('ee_delta',a,include_depth=True,video='none',note=tag)
  elif typ=='stop':break
  else:raise ValueError(typ)
  record(o,tag)
  (out/'response.json').write_text(json.dumps({'ok':True,'n':n}))
 except Exception as e:
  traceback.print_exc();(out/'response.json').write_text(json.dumps({'ok':False,'error':str(e)}))
